title: Harness report envelope contract
description: Generic report envelope shared by every harness function. Function output contracts extend this envelope with function-specific result properties; error outcomes use the same envelope and optional error detail. Every function's `out` value is a concrete report: the exact object returned by the service, rendered by the command, forwarded unchanged by the hook adapter, and persisted byte-identically as the log entry's `report` (see log-entry.schema.json).

context.description: Replay and correlation context identifying the function, session, and workflow instance.

status.description: The outcome status of the function invocation.

code.description: Stable error code for programmatic handling.

retryable.description: Whether the caller may retry the same invocation.

error.description: Error detail object; required when status is an error status, forbidden otherwise.

outcome.description: The function outcome: a status plus, on error statuses, an error detail object.

errorStatus.description: The set of error statuses every harness function may return.
